R_schema.P_expansion_rule: R replaces every argv occurrence of every P_compile_time_slot exactly once. Any remaining argv brace must name a declared runtime_late_slot. OUTPUT_PATH and CHILD_CHECKPOINT_PATH are wrapper-resolved from the actual initial/resume attempt only after history and fencing validation, using R_paths; they cannot be frozen to a0 or supplied by the dispatcher. RUN_BINDINGS_PATH is replaced only by the wrapper with the absolute, read-only path already validated from its --bindings-file argument; its file must be the exact run_bindings_revision blob from the separate bindings checkout and must not be copied into source. For c6.base_plus_s.l1 the wrapper must validate the direct qualification producer, read its base_producer_identity, resolve that exact transitive Base artifact, and replace both BASE_PRODUCER_* slots; the runtime binding signature covers both producer identities. A declared direct producer runtime slot may be wrapper-only for L4 because the unchanged official stress child does not consume L2 evidence; the wrapper must still resolve and validate both direct producer slots before child import. Unknown/missing required slots, duplicate record IDs, non-allowlisted entrypoints or argv differences are invalid.
R_schema.self_identity_rule: R does not contain its own commit/blob/hash. The workflow's run_bindings_revision is the exact checked-out R commit; the checked-out R blob and full-byte hash are verified against D and every sealed envelope. record_signature is static and frozen in R; runtime binding_signature is distinct and binds producer/D/C/resolved item-manifest identity without rewriting R.

attempt_policy.resume_attempt_id_derivation: `r${resume_sequence}-${12_lowercase_hex}` with resume_sequence starting at 1; <=63 chars; a fresh random suffix is required
attempt_policy.resume_workflow_run_id_schema: ^$|^[1-9][0-9]*$ and strictly less than current GITHUB_RUN_ID
attempt_policy.fencing_sequence: numeric GITHUB_RUN_ID; GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT is provenance only and must equal 1
attempt_policy.logical_run_id_binding: Each binding record copies its exact immutable logical_run_id from the corresponding P binding_spec; the seven P values are pairwise unique. The wrapper rejects the workflow input unless it equals that R/P value before history lookup or child import.

child_environment.rule: No other C6_* variable reaches the child. The token is a runner-generated concurrency nonce, not an authentication secret or workflow-dispatch input. It is masked before any later step and may exist only in wrapper/child process environment; raw bytes are forbidden from argv, logs, downloaded/uploaded artifacts, payloads, checkpoints, envelopes and sidecars, where only SHA-256 may persist. C6_BOUND_RESUME_SIGNATURE exists only after the wrapper authenticates a prior diagnostic checkpoint; it binds the old signature while the new attempt writes its fresh signature.

run_templates.output_paths: R derives wrapper-owned normalized paths under artifacts/checkpoints/c6/{logical_run_id}/; no placeholder may select an importable package path. RUN_BINDINGS_PATH is an absolute read-only input under the separate bindings checkout. L4 additionally permits only the two frozen official child publication targets in L4_official_output_selector inside the ephemeral source checkout; the wrapper copies exactly one byte-for-byte into its export and does not retain a source-tree mutation. Fresh diagnostics use payload.json.gz and internal child-checkpoint.bin.gz; sealed checkpoint member remains child-checkpoint.bin. Compression is transport only and is frozen in canonical_result_payload_hashing.diagnostic_transport.
run_templates.no_runtime_candidate_switch: I_B contains only Base production behavior and cannot execute S, while its diagnostic entrypoint records the preregistered read-only S qualification evidence. I_S is I_B plus the one frozen S production behavior. Candidate selection occurs solely by exact source checkout and R record.

canonical_result_payload_hashing.strict_json: UTF-8 only; reject duplicate keys, non-string keys, NaN, Infinity and -Infinity
canonical_result_payload_hashing.serialization: json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) encoded UTF-8 plus exactly one trailing LF
canonical_result_payload_hashing.digest: SHA-256 over exact canonical payload bytes

L4_extraction.official_artifact_rule: The official artifact bytes and schema are unchanged.
L4_extraction.result_validation: Strict-parse and validate the complete unchanged official artifact with official_L4_artifact, including native provenance/configuration and every exact result family. Project exactly the listed common and status-selected variant fields into official_L4_payload for canonical hashing. All metrics, trade counts, aggregates, gates and status are retained; native source/runtime/config provenance remains authenticated by the separate full-byte artifact hash. Fresh L4 requires the compared initial-baseline variant; historical no-transition-reference artifacts are read-only references, not fresh L4 candidates.
L4_extraction.results_order: lexicographic scenario_id exactly as sealed by the official runner
L4_extraction.missing_semantics: Any listed common field absent from the official artifact is invalid. Accepted initial L4 requires exactly baseline_kind as the listed variant field; rejected L4 requires exactly rejection_reasons as the listed variant field. The variant is selected only by the existing official publication status, never by the extractor.

raw_fencing_token_persistence_boundary.dispatch_metadata_exception: none; the nonce is generated on the runner and is not a workflow_dispatch input
raw_fencing_token_persistence_boundary.mask_before_use: the pinned workflow generates the nonce without logging it, emits add-mask in the initializer step, and only then writes it to GITHUB_ENV for later validation, checkout, install, child execution and export validation
raw_fencing_token_persistence_boundary.persisted_identity: SHA-256 only outside the dispatch metadata exception

canonical_result_payload_hashing.hash_order: Atomically seal the existing artifact first; compute canonical_result_payload_sha256 and artifact_full_byte_sha256; write digest sidecar; write manifest last with full-byte hashes of every non-manifest file. No digest is written into the artifact it hashes.
canonical_result_payload_hashing.artifact_full_byte_sha256_definition: Hash of payload.json for L1/qualification/L2 and official-artifact.json for L4; never the self-containing export directory.
canonical_result_payload_hashing.manifest_sha256_use: The manifest full-byte hash may be recorded only by the external consumer/producer identity after download; it is not self-embedded.

diagnostic_transport.codec: gzip level 1, empty filename, mtime 0, strict JSON UTF-8 plus LF before compression
diagnostic_transport.artifact_digest: full-byte SHA-256 and size cover the immutable compressed artifact; canonical_result_payload_sha256 covers the complete decoded canonical JSON
diagnostic_transport.checkpoint: diagnostic child-checkpoint.bin contains gzip-compressed exact canonical child checkpoint; physical byte hash and size cover compressed bytes, exact completed prefix and every result hash are verified after bounded decoding
diagnostic_transport.official_L4: no compression or modification of official artifact/checkpoint schema or bytes
diagnostic_transport.failure: corrupt gzip/CRC, malformed JSON, oversized records/decoded payload, mismatch or ambiguity fails closed; no truncated evidence accepted
diagnostic_transport.storage: disk spools use concatenated independent gzip members with logical byte offsets; file arrays stream decoded records and never cache entire scenarios

workflow_trigger_matrix.regression_behavior: Only the closed node-selected engineering suite executes during pre-freeze; explicit real-data economic node selectors must resolve and are excluded; unknown tests fail closed; Exact backtest regression executes embargo identity only; five-universe replay skipped

workflow_trigger_matrix.precondition: new branch; one-parent trigger commit; parent equals workflow_revision; only A .github/c6-dispatch-request.json; strict canonical request and branch identity
workflow_trigger_matrix.output_boundary: One exact workflow_dispatch API request; no source import or economic computation

workflow_trigger_matrix.precondition: P,I_B,I_S,R exact remote identities frozen; predecessor and D rules by stage
workflow_trigger_matrix.duplicate_prevention: concurrency, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT=1, exhaustive run history, exact predecessor, one result per logical run
workflow_trigger_matrix.output_boundary: One validated sealed 90-day artifact per logical run; repository checkouts read-only
CI logs only; no C6 artifact

workflow_trigger_matrix.precondition: successful terminal predecessor with exact sealed incomplete checkpoint, unchanged workflow anchor, no later attempt
workflow_trigger_matrix.output_boundary: single successor workflow_dispatch; no candidate imports or economic computation

workflow_trigger_matrix.precondition: successful terminal predecessor with exact sealed incomplete checkpoint, unchanged workflow anchor, no later attempt
workflow_trigger_matrix.output_boundary: single successor workflow_dispatch; no candidate imports or economic computation

workflow_trigger_matrix.precondition: trusted completion request names exact predecessor; wait for successful terminal state then authenticate all existing evidence and no later attempt
workflow_trigger_matrix.output_boundary: single successor workflow_dispatch; no candidate imports or economic computation

implementation_freeze.required_review: Focused exact-tree correctness/security review for I_B/I_S with zero unresolved Critical/Important defects before dispatch. Recovery classification A/B remains authorized after observations; economic hypotheses never retune.
implementation_freeze.import_surface: Exact checkout only; clean index/tracked/untracked state; PYTHONPATH contains only that checkout; outputs remain under non-importable artifacts/checkpoints/c6.

implementation_identity_rules.I_B_comparison_base: the exact containing P commit recorded by R; its tree must equal the containing P tree and P must be the first-parent ancestor of I_B
implementation_identity_rules.I_B_diff: git diff --raw -z and git diff --numstat -z over P_commit..I_B_commit; every changed path must be an exact I_B_allowed_paths member; no rename, copy, delete, symlink, gitlink, submodule, mode change or path outside the allowlist
implementation_identity_rules.I_B_history: git rev-list --merges --first-parent P_commit..I_B_commit is empty; every first-parent step is a single-parent commit
implementation_identity_rules.I_S_comparison_base: the exact frozen I_B commit/tree recorded in the same R; I_B must be the first-parent ancestor of I_S
implementation_identity_rules.I_S_diff: git diff --raw -z and git diff --numstat -z over I_B_commit..I_S_commit; every changed path must be an exact I_S_allowed_paths member; no rename, copy, delete, symlink, gitlink, submodule, mode change or path outside the allowlist
implementation_identity_rules.I_S_history: git rev-list --merges --first-parent I_B_commit..I_S_commit is empty; every first-parent step is a single-parent commit
implementation_identity_rules.budget_measurement: added_lines and deleted_lines are the exact sums of decimal git diff --numstat fields; binary markers are forbidden; changed_paths is the unique byte-order-sorted path array from the same diff
implementation_identity_rules.R_requirement: R stores both implementation identities with their exact comparison-base identities and diff proofs; the bound runner replays these Git checks before importing either source tree

budget_basis.reason: Existing reviewed v11 implementation plus bounded metadata/record-validation regression coverage; same exact paths and economic formulas. No data/config/gate/formal-runner changes.

selection_rule.D_commit_rule: D has exactly R as first parent, changes only D_path as a new regular mode-100644 blob, and has no other tree change.
selection_rule.step_1: Run exactly c6.base.l1 and validate the entire 3831-evaluation/29-control/15-no-drift payload.
selection_rule.step_2: Invalid Base identity/schema cannot produce D or a successor. A/B defects invalidate the execution revision and are repaired/rebound under recovery_continuation; a valid economic diagnostic rejection follows this same mechanical selection contract. S is never used to disguise a correctness defect.
selection_rule.step_3: Derive complete R_L1 only from the 765 C6-Base evaluation records using the frozen unrounded MDD predicate.
selection_rule.step_4: If R_L1 is empty, do not dispatch qualification or Base+S. Select I_B iff every Base L1 predicate passes; otherwise reject.
selection_rule.step_5: If R_L1 is nonempty, dispatch exactly c6.s.qualification with the exact Base producer. Base+S is eligible only if the complete qualification result has all_passed=true.
selection_rule.step_6: If qualified, dispatch exactly c6.base_plus_s.l1 with the exact qualification producer and its transitive Base identity. Select I_S iff every Base+S L1 predicate passes; otherwise reject.
selection_rule.step_7: D binds P/R, every required sealed artifact hash, complete residual IDs, predicate arrays, qualification hash or null, selected candidate and exact C. Preselection artifacts remain unselected and are never rewritten.
selection_rule.step_8: Only the D-selected candidate-specific L2 record may dispatch. L4 requires the exact successful complete L2 producer, every L2 predicate passed, and the same D/C.

D_validator.input: R checkout, D checkout and downloaded sealed artifacts
D_validator.qualification_required_iff: R_L1 is nonempty, Base L1 is schema-valid, and every non-deferred Base predicate passes. D must retain the exact qualification artifact identity when this condition holds, including all_passed=false. If Base is invalid or any non-deferred Base predicate fails, qualification is forbidden and D stops immediately.
D_validator.base_plus_s_l1_required_iff: R_L1 is nonempty and the complete qualification artifact has all_passed=true; if qualification fails, Base+S L1 is null and D status is rejected
D_validator.rejected_mapping: selected_candidate and C are null; downstream L2/L4 forbidden

economic_tree_and_A.allowed_change: only add or modify regular non-executable 100644 blobs at exact allowlisted paths; no delete, rename, symlink or gitlink
economic_tree_and_A.runner_read_exclusion: No A_ALLOWLIST path is read by the official runner, gate implementation, scenario generator, dependency/config loader or C6 selection validator. In particular prefix_stress.json and universe_stress.json are excluded from A because the official runner reads universe_stress.json as incumbent state; official L4 bytes remain only in the sealed external artifact for this experiment.

manifest_record_value_contract.path_b64: standard RFC 4648 padded base64 of the exact raw repo-relative path bytes
manifest_record_value_contract.mode: six ASCII Git mode digits from ls-tree
manifest_record_value_contract.object_oid: lowercase hexadecimal Git object OID emitted by ls-tree

economic_tree_and_A.manifest_algorithm: Read the entire tracked tree using git-ls-tree -rz --full-tree semantics; remove only exact A_ALLOWLIST paths; construct each object with exactly manifest_record_exact_keys and no others; sort records by decoded raw path bytes; serialize the record array with json.dumps(records, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) plus one LF encoded as UTF-8; SHA-256 the exact bytes.
economic_tree_and_A.required_proof: git diff --raw -z C A touches only allowed 100644 add/modify paths and economic_tree_hash(C) equals economic_tree_hash(A)
economic_tree_and_A.fallback: If source/head validation or required CI would rerun L4, keep A null and retain the sealed workflow artifact externally.

frozen_file_identity_origin.rule: Every entry in frozen_file_identities is resolved and byte-verified at exactly authority.base_revision. The economic dispatch workflow independently binds run_templates.workflow.revision; at P both origins intentionally have identical workflow bytes.

stop_conditions: Do not dispatch a new economic execution until exact new P/I_B/I_S/R and real boundary/cloud probe evidence are remotely verified.
Do not mutate old frozen objects or resume the invalid v11 logical run.

Any identity, data, schema, formula, runtime or history mismatch blocks the affected execution; classify A/B/C/D under authority.recovery_continuation. A/B recovery is already authorized and preserves history.
Unauthorized warm holdings/cash/peaks/orders/locks or future information, invalid raw data or universe-dependent old-symbol indicators cannot be accepted.
A valid Base residual qualification failure, eligible Base+S predicate failure, selected L2 failure or formal L4 gate rejection blocks promotion under the frozen mechanical rules.
No third candidate, tuning, economic threshold/scenario/reference changes, allocator or account-lock weakening.
Native GitHub rerun, missing/expired history, a prior run without valid sealed evidence, duplicate result or broken producer lineage permanently invalidates that logical run; never forge a successor.
L4 exit2 is a valid economic rejection when its schema/provenance and native gates validate; no resume or renamed rerun for outcome selection.
Required checks/reviews and GitHub protection must pass at the exact head. Main drift permits normal merge and actual dependency revalidation; no bypass or unsupported extra expected-base CAS.
Any recovered result must carry truthful source/data/runtime. Old observations never become an independent out-of-sample result by changing a revision name.
unknowns_before_implementation: Exact I_B and I_S commit/tree/blob identities are unknown until their reviewed clean trees are frozen; P supplies only exact construction and R schemas.
Exact R commit/blob/full-byte identity is unknown until both implementations and runtime probe values are frozen.
Base residual IDs and S qualification outcome are intentionally unknown until the one bound Base L1 result; they cannot alter S code, formulas or schemas.
D, C and downstream producer artifact hashes are intentionally unknown until mechanical selection; only their exact late-binding schemas are open.
New revision economic results remain unknown. Historical transition report and old 530 baseline observations have been seen and retained; no new economic replay is used to design this repair.

diagnostic_api_contract.production_signature_rule: ProductionReplayEngine.run accepts neither an intervention nor a trace sink and cannot reach diagnostic intervention branches.

field_types.recording_mode: enum DEFAULT|OFF|ON; OFF/ON are permitted only for the selected stage candidate in the exact 15-ID no-drift manifest
field_types.scenario_id: string from the exact binding evaluation manifest

diagnostic_api_contract.W_identity_rule: For each W evaluation, evaluation_id is exactly evaluation_prefix::add-one-13-601869, evaluation_record.variant_id equals variant_id, diagnostic_request.intervention_id equals request_intervention_id, and intervention_result.intervention_id equals result_intervention_id at the same W_identity_map ordinal. No case/spelling normalization is permitted.
diagnostic_api_contract.variant_mapping_rule: The map is exact and bijective. Every evaluation ID prefix must resolve through it; no spelling normalization, fallback, runtime candidate switch or additional intervention is allowed. No-drift pairs reuse C6_BASE or C6_BASE_PLUS_S with recording_mode OFF then ON.

field_types.events: array of trace_event in engine emission order

array_order.events: engine emission order; each item owns zero-based emission_ordinal

forbidden_transport: candidate switch in I_B or I_S
diagnostic_api_contract.default_instrumentation_no_drift: RECORDING_OFF and RECORDING_ON must have identical orders, fills, cash, positions and equity hashes; factual trace bytes are excluded from the equality.

schema_catalog.dialect: closed JSON Schema subset implemented by c6_bound_run.validate_wire_schema/value; exact keys, explicit nullable types, finite numeric values and bounded raw JSON
schema_catalog.strict_json: UTF-8 only; reject duplicate keys, non-string keys, NaN, Infinity and -Infinity
schema_catalog.schema_reference_rule: Every #/$defs/name resolves to definitions[name].wire_schema. Metadata field_types names index references only; wire_schema is the executable field contract.

cross_field_invariants.reason: first failing condition in the frozen precedence; NONE iff qualification_fillability.nonzero_executable_lot is true and shares=0

cross_field_invariants.sleeve_cash: exactly three state_index 0,1,2 records; states 0 and 1 equal initial_capital/3 under production float semantics, state 2 equals initial_capital minus the first two; sum exactly initial_capital; no pre-window cash mutation
cross_field_invariants.sleeve_peaks: exactly three records aligned with sleeve_cash; every cycle_peak_assets, lifetime_peak_assets and daily_start_assets equals that sleeve's initial cash
cross_field_invariants.account_peaks: cycle_peak_assets, lifetime_peak_assets and daily_start_assets each equal initial_capital
cross_field_invariants.locks: exactly three sleeve records plus one account record; cycle_lock, emergency_lock and terminal_lock are literal false and rearm_remaining_trading_days is literal 0 for every record
cross_field_invariants.timestamps: every causal source/asof timestamp is strictly before first_decision_timestamp; first_execution_timestamp is the scheduler-selected next tradable open after first_decision_timestamp
cross_field_invariants.failure: any violation makes the evaluation invalid before metrics or predicates are consumed

calendar_derivation.dates: byte-sort the unique normalized YYYY-MM-DD indices from every scenario symbol raw frame satisfying start_date <= date <= end_date
calendar_derivation.serialization: UTF-8 dates joined by LF plus exactly one terminal LF

array_order.pre_breach_wealth_gaps: comparison order VS_W0 then VS_PREVIOUS_FORWARD; omit self-comparison for W0 and duplicate W1 comparison

cross_field_invariants.intervention_presence: intervention_601869 is non-null iff scenario_id=add-one-13-601869 and variant_id equals one W_identity_map.variant_id; otherwise literal null
cross_field_invariants.intervention_identity: when non-null, evaluation_id/variant_id/request/result identities must match one exact diagnostic_api_contract.W_identity_map row and intervention_601869.scenario_id equals scenario_id
cross_field_invariants.calendar: data_identity.calendar_hash is recomputed from scenario_definition.symbols and frozen raw frames before any metric is accepted

cross_field_invariants.assertion_identity: actual assertion id, expected and comparator equal the per-control frozen assertion spec at the same ordinal

array_order.no_effect_comparisons: all qualifying evaluation IDs in L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST order

cross_field_invariants.common_prefix_coverage: common_prefix_comparisons length is exactly 765 and scenario_id sequence exactly equals L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST IDs
cross_field_invariants.no_effect_coverage: length equals the complete count of L1_S evaluations with s_effective_count=0 and item_id sequence equals the frozen filtered L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST order; synthetic controls are forbidden; missing, duplicate or extra entries are invalid
cross_field_invariants.producer_binding: For each comparison, parse the scenario suffix from the C6-Base+S item/scenario ID, derive base_evaluation_id exactly as C6-Base::<same suffix>, require exactly one matching evaluation_record in the transitive sealed c6.base.l1 producer, and recompute every Base hash from that exact record. Every S hash is recomputed from the exact same-ID evaluation in this payload. A hash copied from any different Base/S record is invalid.
cross_field_invariants.common_prefix_counterpart: Every common_prefix_comparison.scenario_id equals the C6-Base+S evaluation_id at the same ordinal and base_evaluation_id equals C6-Base::<the identical scenario suffix>; first_s_effective_timestamp is recomputed from that S record and both prefix hashes are recomputed at the identical strict-before boundary.
cross_field_invariants.no_effect_counterpart: Every no_effect_comparison.item_kind is evaluation, item_id equals its exact C6-Base+S evaluation_id, base_evaluation_id equals C6-Base::<the identical scenario suffix>, and s_effective_count is recomputed from that S record before all five complete-path hashes are recomputed.

array_order.cases: official results order filtered to add_one

array_order.results: lexicographic scenario_id exactly as official runner emits
lexicographic scenario_id as emitted by the official full-plan runner checkpoint

array_order.completed_item_ids: exact prefix of binding item manifest

tagged_union_by_branch.BASE_REJECTED: status=rejected; Base artifact is valid; s_qualification=null; base_plus_s_l1=null; base_plus_s_l1_predicates=null; selected_candidate=null; C=null; rejection_reasons exactly [BASE_L1_PREDICATE_FAILED]; applies iff any non-deferred Base predicate fails, whether residual_ids is empty or nonempty
tagged_union_by_branch.BASE_SELECTED: status=selected; residual_ids=[] with empty-list SHA-256; every Base predicate passed; s_qualification=null; base_plus_s_l1=null; base_plus_s_l1_predicates=null; selected_candidate=C6-Base; C=I_B; rejection_reasons=[]
tagged_union_by_branch.QUALIFICATION_REJECTED: status=rejected; residual_ids nonempty; every non-deferred Base predicate passed; s_qualification non-null and complete with all_passed=false; base_plus_s_l1=null; base_plus_s_l1_predicates=null; selected_candidate=null; C=null; rejection_reasons exactly [S_QUALIFICATION_FAILED]
tagged_union_by_branch.BASE_PLUS_S_REJECTED: status=rejected; residual_ids nonempty; every non-deferred Base predicate passed; s_qualification non-null complete/all_passed=true; base_plus_s_l1 non-null valid; base_plus_s_l1_predicates non-null with at least one failure; selected_candidate=null; C=null; rejection_reasons exactly [BASE_PLUS_S_L1_PREDICATE_FAILED]
tagged_union_by_branch.BASE_PLUS_S_SELECTED: status=selected; residual_ids nonempty; every non-deferred Base predicate passed; s_qualification non-null complete/all_passed=true; base_plus_s_l1 non-null valid; every Base+S predicate passed; selected_candidate=C6-Base+S; C=I_S; rejection_reasons=[]

D_selection.union_validation: Exactly one branch variant must match every field. Static contract tests must instantiate and accept each of the five branch variants, then reject a missing branch, an unknown branch and every cross-branch field combination. No downstream artifact may be retained after BASE_REJECTED. Invalid Base/Base+S payload, malformed/incomplete qualification, or invalid producer is abnormal and stops without D.

array_order.results: lexicographic scenario_id exactly as official runner emits

qualification_criterion.validation_rule: The validator resolves every input_path directly from the sealed Base evaluation and recomputes the criterion formula; passed and failure_reason must equal that recomputation. Nested stored pass booleans are evidence fields that must themselves satisfy their schema cross-field formulas, never trusted decision inputs.

checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.abnormal_exit_rule: Any other child/bound-run exit is failure. It may upload a sealed checkpoint only if checkpoint validation completed; it may never be converted to a rejected or passed result.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.l4_exit_2: A valid, sealed, terminal rejected official result; never classified as checkpointed-incomplete and never rerun in this experiment.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.generic_vs_official: The wrapper validates identity/progress and hashes the child checkpoint. L1/QUALIFICATION/L2 child_checkpoint_kind=c6_diagnostic_shard_v2 must satisfy schema_catalog.definitions.diagnostic_child_checkpoint. L4 child_checkpoint_kind=official_stress_v2 must satisfy schema_catalog.definitions.official_stress_child_checkpoint and additionally pass the frozen official stress checkpoint loader/validator byte-for-byte; the wrapper never rewrites or canonicalizes child checkpoint bytes. Diagnostic child binary is deterministic gzip of the exact canonical JSON; wrapper validates compressed physical bytes then complete decoded prefix/record hashes. Official L4 checkpoint bytes remain plain and unchanged.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.resume_from: Exact SHA-256 of the prior sealed checkpoint_wrapper canonical bytes, never a path or opaque token.

history_query.API: GitHub Actions list workflow runs plus list artifacts, actions:read
history_query.pagination: exhaust every page until no result; failure, truncation, rate-limit ambiguity or inaccessible history is STOP
history_query.current_exclusion: exclude only exact current GITHUB_RUN_ID after validating it has the same workflow/event/head SHA

checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.administrative_trust_boundary: The protocol prevents accidental duplicate evaluation and fails closed on every visible run lacking a valid result/checkpoint. It does not claim cryptographic resistance to a repository administrator deleting GitHub Actions run history itself. Manual run/artifact deletion, retention reduction below 90 days, or loss of exhaustive actions:read visibility invalidates the entire C6 experiment; operators must not redispatch any affected logical_run_id. This is an explicit platform trust assumption, not evidence that an absent artifact means no execution.

state_machine.NEW: No prior matching run exists; resume inputs empty.
state_machine.RESUME_ALLOWED: Exactly one latest sealed checkpoint chain exists, no result exists, prior workflow run is terminal/inactive, resume_workflow_run_id equals that run and resume_from equals its wrapper hash.
state_machine.TERMINAL_RESULT: Any valid prior result exists; current run exits before importing or executing economic code.
state_machine.INVALID_HISTORY: Any prior matching run has neither a valid sealed result nor valid sealed checkpoint, has conflicting artifacts, broken predecessor chain, unavailable/expired evidence, or ambiguous pagination; STOP permanently for this logical run.

checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.takeover: A new workflow_dispatch with a new run ID, derived resume attempt ID and new fencing token is required. GitHub rerun is forbidden. Concurrency plus history preflight must complete before the child imports.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.writer_rule: Only the current highest valid GITHUB_RUN_ID fencing sequence may atomically publish into its local attempt path. A stale writer cannot update pointers or seal. Each attempt writes a versioned path and atomically renames only after hashes validate.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.completion_once: Exactly one valid result for a logical_run_id. Discovery of two results is INVALID_HISTORY, not a tie-break.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.checkpoint_progress: completed_item_ids must be an exact prefix of the binding item manifest; resume starts at next_item_ordinal and never recomputes a completed shard. Every new/restored diagnostic record passes actual wire types and applicable within-record formulas before entering a reusable prefix; whole-stage and dependent-group predicates execute only when the group/stage is complete.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.platform_rule: No valid checkpoint means no successor for that logical run. Preserve forensic artifacts; classify the cause, repair A/B with new immutable execution identities and affected reruns under this authorization.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.budget_rule: Diagnostics: 3600 seconds from immutable P; chunks remain 10 and full W group is atomic. Measured 530 full-record semantic checks cost 494 seconds locally, so longer segments amortize restore authentication. After each chunk persist exact validated prefix; yield75 only at incomplete boundary after new work. Official L4 retains its existing native 900-second budget and checkpoint format. No 10-minute interactive wait rule is treated as economic segment length.
